response.summary:
At the 1048x858 viewport the user reported, version 10's type is much easier to read than 09's. Text-on-paper contrast is higher, secondary text is larger, mixed-case Manrope labels replace the tracked mono caps, and the badge now says "Ctrl K" instead of the mixed "⌘ / Ctrl K". The italic greeting and strapline are gone, Newsreader is used only for h1, and the shortcut badge is hidden at 390px. The 390px, Practice, Review, Work and teacher Students captures read cleanly and show no lost information. The source keeps the exact-reference parser, the five synthetic questions, the fixed 3/5 Review history, work filters, draft/note error handling, dialog focus return and route guards.

There is one material problem left. At 768px, which is an acceptance width, the two-column right stack breaks text-button labels mid-phrase ("Prepare a / note", "Mark as / read", "Eastern / time"). The same thing happens more severely at 200% text. Smaller problems: "Timed section" wraps at the user's 1048 viewport, some fixed-px chips don't grow with 200% text, the shortcut handler has key-matching and data-loss edge cases, and the host suite has coverage gaps.

findings.evidence: In artifacts/home-768.png the coach and session panels sit side by side about 245px wide. 'Prepare a note' breaks into two centred lines with the arrow detached. 'Mark as read' breaks into 'Mark as / read'. 'Eastern time' breaks into 'Eastern / time'. 'About Conditional Indicators Refresher' wraps to two lines. text-200-home-1048.png shows the same breaks at a much narrower width. The typography suite passes because nothing overflows, but these buttons now read as ragged fragments. BRIEF acceptance lists 768 and 200% text.
findings.fix: Add white-space:nowrap to .text-button labels and flex-wrap:wrap to .session-row and .message-actions so whole actions move to their own line. Alternatively, keep .right-stack in a single column below about 900px (or switch with a container query on the panel width). Add a check that fails when a single control label wraps onto multiple lines.

findings.evidence: At 1048, in home-1048-viewport.png and home-1048.png, 'Timed section' wraps to two lines while 'Smart Drill' and 'Inbox 1' stay on one line. The three buttons look uneven in the first screen of the exact viewport the user rejected.
findings.fix: Use white-space:nowrap on quick-action labels with slightly tighter padding at 1001–1200px. Alternatively, use grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(9rem,1fr)) so the row reflows instead of breaking a label.

findings.evidence: At 200% text (text-200-home-1048.png) the fixed-px .work-type chips (height:26px, min-width:29px) can no longer hold their 'LR'/'RC' text, so the chip boxes visibly collapse behind the enlarged glyphs. The '1 new' count wraps into '1 / new' inside its tinted box. The Mon tile's inline 4px event dot renders as '.Session'. In sidebar-200-1048.png the role select shows a truncated 'Student · A'. The m.clipped and assignmentTextOverflow checks did not flag any of this.
findings.fix: Size the chips in rem (min-height:1.625rem; min-width:1.8rem; padding:0 .3em). Add white-space:nowrap to .count and .badge. Size the dots in em. Let the sidebar-foot select show a shorter value or allow wrapping at large text, e.g. option text 'Student' / 'Teacher' with the name in the identity block.

findings.evidence: The handler accepts e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey on every platform. On Windows, Win+K (the system Cast/Connect shortcut) also opens the finder. On Mac, Ctrl+K (the standard 'kill to end of line' text-editing key) is intercepted inside textareas. This contradicts the single binding the badge and aria-keyshortcuts advertise. The shortcut also fires while the prepare-note or Negation-rewrite dialog is open: it calls closeDialog() and navigates away, discarding unsaved typed text with no warning. That behaviour was probably inherited from 09, but this generation changed the shortcut presentation.
findings.fix: Match the advertised key only: applePlatform ? e.metaKey&&!e.ctrlKey : e.ctrlKey&&!e.metaKey. When a modal textarea holds unsaved input, either ignore the shortcut or keep the dialog open and focus the finder after confirmation.

findings.evidence: The platform results in typography-report.json record badge:null even for the windows and mac fixtures. Line 17 reads .finder kbd after Ctrl/Meta+K has already navigated to Practice, so the report cannot show which label was displayed, although the line-14 assertion did check it. The type and 200% loops cover only student routes. Teacher, Students and open dialogs are never measured, even though the BRIEF lists teacher views and dialogs. motion-focus-report predates the final CSS wrap repair (the plan says so).
findings.fix: Record the badge text before pressing the shortcut. Add teacher, students and at least one open dialog (prepare note, draft assignment) to the normal and 200% loops. Re-run motion/focus against the frozen hashes.

coverage: Read in full: BRIEF.md, index.html, style.css, app.js (current files, not hash-verified by me; reviews/round-1-source-hashes.json read: index 6706D017…, app 9AE72846…, style A464A716…)

Images read: before-home-1048.png, home-1048.png, home-1048-viewport.png, before-home-390.png, home-390.png, home-1440.png, home-768.png, practice-390.png, review-390.png, work-390.png, teacher-students-390.png, text-200-home-1048.png, text-200-home-390.png, sidebar-200-1048.png
